title: Senior Engineering Manager - Agent Platform, AI Platform
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence powers innovation in all areas of the business, from helping members choose the right entertainment for them through personalization, to better understanding our audience and our content slate, to optimizing our payment processing and other revenue-focused initiatives. Building highly scalable and differentiated ML infrastructure is key to accelerating this innovation.

The Opportunity

Agents are becoming a primary way software gets built and work gets done at Netflix — and the AI Platform is building the foundation they run on. The Agent Platform team owns the agent-specific layer that every agent at Netflix depends on: the runtime and execution environment, memory, identity and permissioning, discovery and registry, evaluation, and the tool/MCP interfaces agents use to act. We build the paved path agent developers across the company build on, and we operate the runtimes for the workloads the general platform can't reach — including at member scale.

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead this team. This is a small, senior, high-leverage group working at the front edge of a domain that is still being invented — where frameworks turn over in months and the durable bets are not obvious. The hardest part of this job is not the code — it is choosing what to build, and what will still matter once today's tools are gone.

You will:

•
Own the charter and technical direction. Set the platform's technical strategy and roadmap — the agent-specific foundation every agent depends on, and the selective runtimes worth operating directly — and decide where to invest ahead of demand.

•
Lead and grow a high performing team. Hire, develop, and retain excellent engineers; set a high bar; and create the conditions for a small team to have outsized impact.

•
Make sharp build, adopt, or partner calls. Decide which capabilities the platform owns and which it draws from partner teams, define the interfaces between them, and keep a small team focused on the highest-leverage layer.

•
Turn the new hard problems into primitives. The most durable problems in this space are the ones that let agents get better from their own experience: capturing each run's full reasoning-and-tool-call trajectory as structured, replayable data; turning real-world outcomes into evaluation signal; memory that compounds across runs; and a feedback loop that turns that signal into improved behavior, promoted behind eval gates and safe rollout. Make these first-class platform capabilities with real contracts — so agents built on the platform measurably improve over time, not just scale.

•
Operate as part of the AI Platform leadership team. Set direction alongside peer leaders across the AI Platform and partner orgs, represent the team in senior technical forums, and build the cross-team alignment a foundational platform depends on.

If you've built platforms and you know that the defining work is judgment — what to own, what to hand off, what to bet on while the ground is still moving — this is the role.

Minimum Qualifications

•
Experience leading and growing engineering teams that build and operate platform or infrastructure at scale — managing senior individual contributors and/or managers, with a track record of developing strong engineers.

•
Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating agentic systems in production — agent runtimes and harnesses, tool use, memory, and evaluation — with genuine technical depth, not oversight from a distance.

•
Breadth across business applications: you've built or led agents spanning a range of use cases, enterprise and internal applications (developer tooling, operations, knowledge work) or consumer-facing applications at scale.

•
A strong engineering foundation in distributed systems, cloud, and ML/AI infrastructure — deep enough to lead a senior team's hardest architectural decisions and earn its trust.

•
A track record of owning a platform's charter — setting its direction and holding its scope against pressure to do everything — and making build-versus-partner decisions on a multi-year cost horizon.

•
Cross-organizational credibility: a record of building shared accountability with senior leaders across adjacent platform, infrastructure, and security teams, and navigating ambiguous ownership boundaries.

•
Strong written and verbal communication; comfort with ambiguity; able to lead both 0-to-1 and 1-to-100 work; effective across a distributed (US) team.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Experience with the emerging class of agent concerns: agent identity and permissioning, guardrails and safety, and cost governance for LLM and agent workloads.

•
Experience running a platform that other engineers consume as a product — paved paths, migrations, deprecations, and developer experience.

•
Credibility in a relevant open-source ecosystem (agent frameworks, runtimes, or developer tooling).

A failure in consent signal propagation or a gap in data stewardship can create compliance exposure and slow roadmaps for partner teams, so this role carries risk and visibility well beyond a single team.

Standard playbooks won't fully apply. You'll need to be a strong partner, evaluate and adapt frameworks as legal requirements evolve, identify gaps in how consent is enforced downstream, and propose new approaches to data minimization — building platforms and systems that are both technically robust and compliant with regulations that weren't written with Netflix's scale in mind.

Increasingly, that innovation is powered by AI — and Netflix is making a deliberate bet to become AI Native, with AI woven into how we build products, create content, and run the company.

The Opportunity

The Agent Platform team gives Netflix engineers the infrastructure to go from zero to a production-grade AI agent without reinventing the wheel. We own the foundational building blocks the whole company builds on: the Model Gateway (unified access to external LLMs like Claude, GPT, and Gemini), the Assistance API for conversational use cases, the MCP Gateway that connects agents to Netflix's internal systems and knowledge, our Agent SDK, and an end-to-end evaluation stack.

The work has moved well beyond chat completions. Teams across Netflix are now building agents — systems that plan, call tools, observe results, and iterate — and they depend on us for the infrastructure to do that reliably and to know whether their agents are actually any good. We're a small team with outsized leverage: what we ship becomes the foundation for AI across all of Netflix.

What you will do:

•
Design, build, and operate the Agent SDK and MCP Gateway that Netflix engineers use to build, deploy, and run AI agents in production.

•
Build agents and agent infrastructure across the full lifecycle — plan/act/observe loops, tool and MCP integrations, deployment, and day-2 operations.

•
Make evaluation a first-class part of the platform: build the tracing, eval suites, and quality signals that let teams measure agents, catch regressions, and iterate to make them better.

•
Own reliability, observability, and guardrails for non-deterministic systems running at very high scale

Lead cross-functional initiatives with ML scientists, data scientists, product managers, and other AI Platform teams.

Hands-on experience building, deploying, operating, AND evaluating LLM agents in production — not just chat-completion apps or prototypes.

•
Experience with one or more agent frameworks/SDKs (Strands, OpenAI Agents SDK, Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, pydantic-ai, CrewAI, Google ADK) and with tool/function calling and MCP.

•
Experience with LLM/agent evaluation and observability — building eval suites, tracing, and quality measurement, then iterating on results (Braintrust, LangSmith, W&B, or equivalent).

•
Strong experience building SDKs and APIs for internal or external developers.

•
Strong fundamentals in building and operating scalable, observable, fault-tolerant distributed systems.

Proficiency in Python (and Python packaging tooling) plus one of Java, Go, C/C++, Rust, or Zig. Familiarity with our stack — Temporal, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes — is a plus.

Developing asset and evidence strategies — synthesizing research, audits and insights into clear frameworks and principles that guide product and creative decisions

title: Software Engineer 6 - Ads Account Foundations
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and we are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

•
Core Accounts: We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

•
Account Intelligence: We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

•
Account Cohort and Verification Automation: Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

•
Spend Attribution: We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

•
7+ years of experience building cloud-based applications with modern programming languages

•
4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

•
Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

•
Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

•
Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

•
Familiarity with Object/Entity lifecycle management and data governance associated with it.

•
Operational excellence experience with customer-facing APIs, including SLO tracking, incident management, and observability tooling,

•
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

•
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Nice to haves:

•
Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g  VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

•
Working knowledge of AI/ML/genAI techniques and an ability to apply them to the account management lifecycle or API reliability monitoring.

•
Early experience with customer-facing MCP concerns, such as defining tools contracts,  security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration), and integration with other AI agents.

•
Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

title: Software Engineer 6 - Ads Account Foundations
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and we are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

•
Core Accounts: We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

•
Account Intelligence: We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

•
Account Cohort and Verification Automation: Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

•
Spend Attribution: We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

•
7+ years of experience building cloud-based applications with modern programming languages

•
4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

•
Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

•
Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

•
Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

•
Familiarity with Object/Entity lifecycle management and data governance associated with it.

•
Operational excellence experience with customer-facing APIs, including SLO tracking, incident management, and observability tooling,

•
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

•
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Nice to haves:

•
Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g  VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

•
Working knowledge of AI/ML/genAI techniques and an ability to apply them to the account management lifecycle or API reliability monitoring.

•
Early experience with customer-facing MCP concerns, such as defining tools contracts,  security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration), and integration with other AI agents.

•
Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Function & Role Overview

The global brand management function is dedicated to shaping the global perception, connection, and experience of the Netflix brand, ensuring it resonates with diverse audiences worldwide and aligns with the company's strategic objectives.

Netflix's brand management team sits within the Brand Creative Studio (BCS) and is collectively responsible for building and maintaining our brand's equity, globally.

The Manager, Brand Management owns manager-level responsibilities within established workstreams, partnering closely with Sr. brand managers and cross-functional partners within and beyond BCS. This role drives specific brand moments and projects from execution through completion, and serves as the go-to point of contact for select global markets, business units, and/or xfn partners activating and integrating the brand. While priorities are set by senior leads, this person is trusted to run with defined workstreams end-to-end, making the calls needed to keep them moving and exercising sound judgment along the way.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, an enabler of breakthrough creative ideas, and a cross-functional relationship-builder — someone who earns trust without formal authority and is ready to grow into fuller ownership of workstreams over time. Strong understanding of brand management, marketing, and consumer behavior is essential, as is comfort operating in complex, ambiguous organizations.

Success in this role is measured as much by the relationships built and BCS/Netflix fluency gained as by the delivery and impact of scoped initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Stewardship

•
Assess Brand Opportunities: Serve as a key point of contact for cross-functional teams and business units surfacing potential brand opportunities, gathering context and framing them clearly for Sr. Managers and the Director to prioritize against.

•
Be a Partner to Key Regions: Serve as the primary point of contact for a defined set of focus markets (e.g. Germany, Italy, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, France) seeking consultation from the broader BCS team on local brand marketing plans and work.  In addition to providing BCS with visibility into local activity, you will also connect dots across global markets where relevant.

Development & Go To Market

•
Ownership of small to mid level projects across various workstreams while also supporting Sr. Manager and the Director on large scale initiatives.

•
Enable End to End Campaign and Creative Development: Support the core BCS functions (strategy,  creative, design, ops & program management) by ensuring xfn and business unit context, objectives and considerations are clear and that xfn feedback is adopted where critical while still defending ambitious ideas.

•
Drive Cross-Functional Integration: Embed within key xfn teams from Social to comms, title marketing and editorial etc. to identify brand integration and activation opportunities to bring to the team for consideration.

•
Support our UCAN-Specific Initiatives: Support the team's UCAN lead on major UCAN brand initiatives, including the Women's World Cup and Kids & Family, helping to strengthen UCAN adoption of our global brand strategy and foundations.

Operational Support & Enablement

•
Manage Operations on Key Projects: create and manage shared forums and tools that strengthen xfn and regional connection to the center and thinking and enable the global brand team to scale our efforts.

•
Maintain Project Health & Coordination: track status, surface blockers, and connect the right people at the right time to keep brand initiatives moving. Cascade decisions and updates across teams and regions, and flag risks to project health early.

•
Provide Thought Leadership & Inspiration: Bring a ground-level point of view back to the team, and use it to sharpen how we prioritize and scale our global brand-building efforts.

Qualifications

•
7-10+ years of experience in brand marketing, agency account management, entertainment marketing or a related field.

•
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams.

•
Excellent relationship-building instincts, with the ability to earn trust and credibility across teams without direct authority.

•
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information clearly for senior stakeholders.

•
Ability to operate effectively within a defined scope while building toward greater ownership and independence.

•
Experience supporting creative teams or working in matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders

•
Detail-oriented with strong organizational and problem-solving skills

•
Comfortable toggling between high-level strategy and executional detail

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $185,000.00 - $308,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

title: Title Producer, Content Localization - UCAN Scripted Series & Documentary
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

As Localization Title Producer, UCAN - Scripted Series, you will ensure that members experience the highest quality dubbed audio and expertly crafted subtitles, preserving creative intent and enhancing the localized experience for viewers everywhere. With Netflix's ongoing international expansion, support for new languages, and the introduction of new content genres, providing world-class dubbing and subtitling services is essential to our success, making this an exciting time to join the company.

The Role

The Localization Title Producer team will serve as the single point of accountability for the end-to-end localization process across all assigned titles in their country or slate. This role is responsible for orchestrating the seamless delivery of dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets, ensuring that all localized content reflects Netflix’s creative vision and meets regional standards for quality and authenticity. This role partners closely with internal and external stakeholders, including Content, Post, Marketing, external partners and more, to optimize workflows, resolve operational challenges, and drive continuous improvement. By championing operational excellence, this role plays a critical role in delivering a world-class member experience and supporting the successful global launch of Netflix content.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Localization Ownership

•
Fully own the operational and tactical localization lifecycle for assigned titles, serving as the single point of accountability from kickoff through global launch.

•
Overseeing all language assets—including dubbing, subtitling, SDH, audio description, marketing supplementals, metadata, main/episodic titles, and forced narratives—proactively managing cross-functional expectations, timelines, budgets, quality control, and ensuring the launch readiness of localized assets for both long form and trailers.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

•
Act as the main point of strategic contact between Content, Post, Marketing, Launch Management, and other internal teams, ensuring alignment and seamless communication throughout the localization process.

•
Facilitate collaboration between Netflix, localization partners, and Language Producers to align timelines, deliverables, and quality standards. Oversee progress, resolve operational challenges, and ensure consistent, authentic localization that meets regional objectives.

Project & Workflow Management

•
Plan, schedule, and manage localization workflows for each assigned title, including setting the language suite strategy and vendor selection, bid management, financial tracking, and asset delivery.

•
Oversee context gathering, complexity assessment, source material distribution, and project tracking while maintaining operational efficiency, ensuring our localization partners are set up to create localized assets that meet the Netflix creative standard.

•
Analyze localization metrics and project data to identify opportunities for workflow optimization and to proactively resolve operational challenges.

Quality, Risk, and Issue Management

•
Identify, assess, and manage project risks, as well as troubleshoot and escalate quality or operational issues as needed, to keep projects on track.

•
Analyze title level localization metrics and data to identify opportunities for workflow optimization and to proactively resolve operational challenges.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

•
Champion the adoption of new practices, workflows, automation, and technology to streamline localization processes and support the integration of emerging media types (live, video podcasts, interactive experiences, etc.).

•
Identify and flag challenges within the current workflow to support ongoing operational improvement.

•
Foster a culture of partnership, transparency, and continuous improvement within the team and with external partners.

Requirements

•
Flexibility to support cross-vertical needs outside of Scripted Series as they arise, at the discretion of the Content Localization Manager/Director.

•
5-7 or more years of experience in localization in a high-demand, fast-paced environment, ideally in the entertainment industry; experience managing large-scale, cross-functional projects in a fast-paced environment.

•
Experience managing high-volume content pipelines, day and date workflows, and/or emerging content formats.

•
Strong systems-thinking and strategic problem-solving skills

•
Ability to handle a fast-paced environment, supervising several projects at various points of production (from development through delivery).

•
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills; able to work effectively in collaboration with creative, operational, technical and product teams.

•
Make sound independent decisions, and know when to escalate issues

•
Highly analytical, data-driven, and solutions-oriented; able to identify root causes, optimize processes, and drive operational excellence.

•
Adaptable and resilient in the face of change and ambiguity; comfortable with evolving priorities, formats, experimentation and new challenges.

•
Passion for operational efficiency, localization or project management.

•
Fluency in English required; additional languages a plus.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $132,000.00 - $220,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. description:

It’s free to enter, and once inside, you can dive into activities that immerse you in your favorite titles with a mix of complimentary and paid experiences. With fresh experiences dropping regularly throughout the year, there's always a new reason to come back.

The Role

As the Facilities Coordinator, you will support the Building Manager to execute the overall maintenance operations for Netflix House Las Vegas. You will ensure that third-party vendors,  repair, and maintenance is proactively maintained and managed.

This on-site, hourly role reports to the Building Manager and is based in Las Vegas, NV.

What you will do:

•
Support the Building Manager in all facility-related operations, including repair coordination, compliance tracking, and upkeep of all areas.

•
Lead the initial administrative setup for the facilities team and transition into the primary administrative point of contact, overseeing facility software, record-keeping, and coordination.

•
Coordinate scheduling and access for third-party vendors performing maintenance, inspections, and repairs.

•
Conduct  on-site repairs and general maintenance tasks, ensuring timely escalation of larger issues. Coordinate with the operations team to minimize Fan disruption when maintenance projects are planned.

•
Respond to calls during operations to maintain a high standard of excellence and functionality for guests when open.

•
Maintain the workshop space so that it is usable for a variety of functions.

•
Assist with daily walkthroughs of the venue, identifying potential issues and ensuring operational readiness across front-of-house, back-of-house, and technical areas.

•
Manage logs, checklists, and digital tracking systems for maintenance, inspections, and compliance documentation.

•
Coordinate with corporate stakeholders to establish best practices in maintenance.

•
Support emergency preparedness procedures, drills, and documentation in partnership with operations and security.

•
Contribute to written updates and reports shared with leadership regarding facility status and ongoing initiatives.

•
Promote and foster a mindset of continuous innovation for internal teams and external partners.

What we need from you:

•
Applicants must be at least 18 years of age to be considered for employment.

•
Demonstrated 3+ years of facilities experience in a fast-paced retail, attraction, or F&B operation preferred.

•
Must have or have the  ability to obtain  and maintain required local credentials, including an LVMPD Non-Gaming Sheriff’s Work Card, SNHD Food Handler Safety Training Card (Health Card), and TAM Card (Alcohol Awareness).

•
Experience within a variety of facility management areas, including HVAC, lighting, plumbing, and general maintenance.

•
Good understanding of Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) and/or OSHA qualification (or willingness to obtain).

•
Experience with digital tools for asset tracking, scheduling, and maintenance logs (e.g., Google Workspace).

•
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across internal departments and external vendors.

•
Resourceful and solutions-focused with a hands-on mindset and a strong attention to detail.

•
Strong desire to think outside the box and innovate.

•
Availability to work days, nights, weekends, and holidays in a 365-day attraction.

•
Physical ability to lift, carry, and move materials up to 50 lbs. Must be able to safely operate warehouse equipment such as pallet jacks, straddle stackers, and hand trucks in accordance with company safety procedures.

title: Distributed Systems Engineer 6 - Membership & Monetization Platform
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Who We Are

Every Netflix membership, from the moment someone signs up to every plan change, renewal, and cancellation flows through our platform. The Membership & Monetization Platform (MMP) team owns the commerce backbone of Netflix: the Tier 0 services that manage subscription state, pricing, and plan availability for ~330 million members across 190+ countries, handling millions of requests per second.

We're a team of engineers who care deeply about correctness at scale, building systems where getting it wrong means real revenue impact. Our platform is the foundation for Netflix's biggest commercial bets, from Ads and Games to Live Streaming.

What You Will Work On

You will be in a leadership role. You will work beyond your own team, driving impact for the org as a whole by shaping longer-term technical strategy, driving cross-functional roadmaps, and scaling your own impact through others.

You'll work across the full spectrum, from product-facing features that directly impact acquisition and retention, to the platform infrastructure that makes them possible at Netflix scale.

You'll partner with product managers, designers, and data scientists to build commerce experiences that drive growth. Recent examples: our systems enabled the password-sharing crackdown, helped launch the Ads-supported plan, and enabled new features for premium members.

On the platform side, you'll tackle distributed systems challenges: race conditions, consistency guarantees and throughput optimization. You’ll evolve our infrastructure to keep pace with Netflix's expanding commerce surface (Ads, Games, Live Streaming). You'll also be part of the on-call rotation for these Tier 0 services, owning production reliability end-to-end.

We're Eager to Talk to You If:

•
You have 15+ years of experience building resilient, high-scale, low-latency distributed systems in production.

•
You've dealt with hard correctness problems: race conditions, eventual consistency, distributed transactions.

•
You have a platform mindset: You can take vague business directives and translate them into scalable and maintainable solutions.

•
You thrive in cross-functional environments and communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-engineering partners.

•
You drive broader strategic impact, delivering beyond your immediate team to shape technical roadmaps and solve cross-functional problems.

•
You scale your impact through coaching, mentoring, and developing other engineers, elevating technical standards across the organization.

•
You take a leadership role on your projects: gathering requirements and driving design, execution and delivery.

Some nice to haves:

•
Working experience with {Java || Kotlin || C# || Scala}, ElasticSearch, Kafka, Hive or AWS.

•
Experience with Presto and/or Spark SQL, Apache Flink

•
Proficient with gRPC, GraphQL, or RESTful API design and implementation.

•
Experience with SQL & NoSQL multi-region data stores such as Cassandra, Amazon Aurora, Memcached.

•
Comfortable with production on-call responsibilities and incident response for Tier 0 services.

•
Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science or a related field.

title: Manager, Social Marketing
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

This is not just a community manager role.

This is not about posting calendars and managing handles.

This is internet marketing at a cultural scale.

We're looking for a cultural operator. A conversation hacker. A genuine content obsessive. Someone who understands the Indian internet deeply, watches everything, and knows how to turn moments into movements. You're as creative as you are analytical — as comfortable pitching a wild idea as you are reading a content slate and knowing exactly which title deserves the internet's attention this week. Loves content coming from different regions in India - Hindi and South. Social at Netflix is a growth engine, an intelligence system, and a brand love machine. If you can balance instinct with insight and culture with craft, this is your playground.

The Mandate

Build and Lead Conversation

•
Grow and nurture the most engaged OTT community in India.

•
Drive always-on cultural presence beyond Title launches

•
Ensure Netflix India consistently leads monthly share of voice and shapes how titles travel across press and KOL ecosystems.

Turn Social into Strategic Intelligence

•
Mine real-time audience feedback, sentiment, and heat signals.

•
Identify breakout moments early and course-correct underperformance fast.

•
Represent the audience voice in internal forums and influence marketing pivots.

You are both a cultural antenna and a performance radar.

Build Brand Love Through Culture

•
Show up meaningfully across festivals, cultural flashpoints, and everyday usage moments.

•
Create and scale social IP that reinforces Netflix's personality.

•

title: Program Manager, Operations
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Our Team

Netflix’s Content & Business Products (CBP) department builds and buys technology that helps create, plan, produce, promote, and distribute the content our subscribers enjoy on the Netflix streaming service. We partner with cross-functional teams to develop cutting-edge solutions that are revolutionizing the entertainment industry.

The Product Directors & Managers in CBP need to (1) plan, prioritize, and execute across multiple product domains; (2) align with multiple sets of business stakeholders; and (3) connect their work to the broader product organization. To support these three altitudes of work, the CBP Operations team provides tactical support to relieve operational overhead.

CBP Programs & Ops strives for consistency via comprehensive support to our product domain leaders and product managers. Our mission is to enhance operational efficiency by centralizing and managing essential resources, fostering effective communication, and exploring innovative technology solutions. To achieve our mission we develop operating models tailored to the product domains we support, helping to provide them with tools and insights needed for our dynamic environment – this foundational work helps us build towards a cohesive operating model for the CBP department.

The Role

Each Program Manager of Operations is responsible for establishing a structured framework and applying operational rigor to each product domain/subdomain they’re assigned to. As a highly organized and execution-driven contributor, you will partner with cross-functional leaders (from Product, Design, Engineering/TPMs, Data Science & Engineering, etc.) to implement & improve annual planning, quarterly planning, OKR & project tracking, communication, and collaboration. When needed you will serve as an end-to-end Program Manager for high-priority initiatives that require dedicated support.

This job description outlines the initial focus areas for the role, but given the dynamic nature of Netflix and our work, the full scope of the role may evolve as needs from CBP leadership change. As operating models become more established in domains/subdomains, CBP Operations maintains structures that work well within each domain and takes on tactical support for large strategic initiatives.

Who You Are & What You’ll Be Doing

•
You are an observer & a doer. You exhibit a strong sense of responsibility and take pride in ownership of driving successful operational practices.

•
You are flexible. You thrive in a dynamic environment and can work with a high degree of autonomy. You will encounter instances in which the next steps are unclear, but you’ll have stunning colleagues to collaborate with and help uncover the best path to take.

•
You are tech forward. We’re experiencing a major change in the workplace with the adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows. You will be expected to contribute to this journey by expressing curiosity, leaning in, and experimenting with new ways to connect our data and work using this new tech.

•
You are a liaison & a great communicator. You strive to increase visibility and be a resource for ‘source of truth’ information, to reduce the cognitive load for your product teams. You involve the right people at the right times.

•
You are passionate about improving operations. Our CBP Operations team is a strategic execution partner in creating and maintaining operating models that enable our product teams to be more efficient

Key Responsibilities

Our goal as a team is to create structure for CBP domains & subdomains to operate with more rigor, to amplify their successes, and to alleviate operational work. To achieve this, each CBP Operations Program Manager will:

•
Aid Product Directors & Managers with tactical programming related to department & domain-level work:

•
Help organize & support annual planning (e.g. create and/or maintain processes, socialize templates, ensure target deadlines are being met) so they can focus on brainstorming, discovery, measurement, and resource allocation.

•
Aid with programming for on/offsites.

•
Provide tactical support to track objectives (business goals) inclusive of initiatives and projects. You will manage the tracking of OKRs (Priorities), helping teams drive progress by ensuring objectives are top of mind; this information will be used for consistent QBR reporting and leadership check-ins.

•
Centralize information and increase visibility for product teams and stakeholders.

•
Maintain documentation and systems used by the product team(s); we’ll first focus on the global aspects of annual planning, ensuring OKRs ladder up to that process, then follow by assisting with quarterly planning.

•
Socialize CBP work via newsletters, media & appropriate forums.

•
Use AI tools to improve workflows and efficiency. Support change management by helping teams adopt and effectively use these new tools.

•
Work closely with counterpart teams such as CBP Engineering Technical Program Management and CBP administrative assistants. Positive partnerships with these teams is essential for the collective success of the department. We collaborate with them by sharing important information, co-authoring documentation, co-programming events, and building & maintaining systems for visibility and tracking purposes.

Preferred Experience/Skills

•
4+ years of applicable program management experience in a Product organization.

•
Proven track record of improving operating models that stretch across multiple business functions.

•
Communication skills to clearly articulate and evangelize concepts across a wide organization.

•
Comfort using a variety of project management and product development tools.

•
Experience in stakeholder relationship management.

title: Software Engineer 6 - Ads Account Foundations
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and we are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

•
Core Accounts: We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

•
Account Intelligence: We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

•
Account Cohort and Verification Automation: Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

•
Spend Attribution: We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. Build and Lead Conversation

Grow and nurture the most engaged OTT community in India.

Drive always-on cultural presence beyond Title launches

Ensure Netflix India consistently leads monthly share of voice and shapes how titles travel across press and KOL ecosystems.

Mine real-time audience feedback, sentiment, and heat signals.

Identify breakout moments early and course-correct underperformance fast.

Represent the audience voice in internal forums and influence marketing pivots.

•
Show up meaningfully across festivals, cultural flashpoints, and everyday usage moments.

Create and scale social IP that reinforces Netflix's personality.

Work with creators for relevance and credibility, not transactional reach.

Own reactive excellence and boosting strategy to maximize cultural impact.

Recognize that the next wave of growth sits beyond metro-heavy legacy communities.

Partner with creators, collaborators, and ecosystem players to widen footprint.

8 to 10+ years of experience in social marketing, having worked in the entertainment industry, network/studio marketing, global lifestyle / digital-first brands, or a creative agency (experience in the entertainment category preferred).

Deep fluency in Indian internet behavior across cohorts and regions.

A genuinely creative mind — someone who concepts, not just executes; who pitches ideas that make a room go quiet.

An obsessive, personal love of content — you watch everything, have opinions on everything, and that excitement shows up in the work.

Able to balance creative instinct with data-led decision making.

Comfortable operating in ambiguity with high ownership.

Strong narrative thinker who understands how social shapes perception.

At Netflix India, social does not amplify culture. It actively shapes it.

Sales Acceleration & Product Evangelism

title: Software Engineer 5 - Ads Authorization (AuthZ) Platform
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Since launching our ad-supported tier in 2022, the momentum has been unstoppable—we reach over 94 million global monthly active users! As we enter our fourth year, our ambition is massive, and we are just getting started.

The Team

The Ads Platform Foundations team builds the core platforms, frameworks, and shared services that accelerate development across the Ads organization. We focus on enabling teams to move faster and build consistently through scalable UI infrastructure, common components, and foundational workflows. Our work also powers access control across domains and underpins core systems such as Public API, GenAI foundations, and the Ads Entity Service — a knowledge graph connecting all Ads entities. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

Responsibilities

•
Co-drive the build vs. buy evaluation for centralized authorization - contribute to vendor bake-offs (Oso, Permit.io, Cerbos, OpenFGA, AuthZed, AWS Verified Permissions/Cedar) against an in-house option, weighing latency, flexibility, operational cost, and vendor lock-in.

•
Help design the policy model: roles vs. permissions vs. relations, org-level vs. resource-level roles, role hierarchies, resource ownership/sharing, multi-tenancy.

•
Partner on the decision engine architecture: low-latency authorization checks, caching, consistency tradeoffs, audit/versioning of policies.

•
Work with platform/security/IAM teams to integrate authz checks into services (sync and async enforcement points).

•
Build reference implementations, SDKs, and middleware so other engineering teams can adopt the centralized model instead of ad hoc checks.

•
Contribute to testing practices (policy unit tests, authorization test suites) and the migration plan from today's scattered checks to a single policy engine.

Must-have qualifications

•
5–8+ years backend/software engineering experience shipping production systems.

•
Hands-on experience working on or building an authorization system - solid RBAC fundamentals, with real understanding of roles, permissions, role hierarchies, and resource-level vs. org-level scoping.

•
Solid conceptual grounding in authz fundamentals - able to reason through tradeoffs between RBAC, ABAC, and ReBAC (relationship-based / Zanzibar-style) approaches.

•
Some exposure to evaluating or integrating a policy engine/framework (Oso, OPA/Rego, Cerbos, OpenFGA, AuthZed/SpiceDB, AWS Cedar) - or having worked on an equivalent in-house.

•
Strong systems design skills: low-latency decision services, caching, consistency vs. performance tradeoffs.

•
Proficient in one backend stack (Java/Kotlin/Go/Node/Python).

Nice-to-have

•
Experience with policy-as-code languages (Rego, Cedar, Polar) or Zanzibar-paper-inspired systems.

•
Has participated in a build-vs-buy or vendor RFP process before.

•
Familiarity with AuthN (OAuth/OIDC) and how the AuthN/AuthZ boundary is typically drawn.

•
Experience on large-scale multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

•
Experience building this external organizations in a b2b (not just internal access controls)

•
Open-source contributions to authz projects (OpenFGA, Cerbos, Casbin, etc.).

title: Software Engineer L5 - AI Observability & Agent Evaluation
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

AI and ML power innovation in all areas of the business, including helping members choose the right title for them through personalization, better understanding our audience and our content slate, creating high-quality subtitles, dubbings, images, trailers, and other assets, optimizing our payment processing, and much more. AI Platform (AIP) organization builds highly scalable, differentiated AI infrastructure to maximize the business impact of all AI/ML practitioners at Netflix, which is key to accelerating this innovation.

The Opportunity

The AI Observability team makes AI, ML, and Agentic systems transparent, reliable, and production-ready at scale. We build end-to-end observability for ML and GenAI workloads, capturing model inputs, features, predictions, outcomes, and behavior across online and batch systems. Our platform enables teams to monitor model performance, data quality, drift, latency, and failures, turning the ML system from a black box into an explainable, debuggable system. We provide developer-friendly libraries, dashboards, and alerts so teams can debug issues, respond to incidents, and ship AI-powered products with confidence.

We're looking for a hands-on senior engineer to build the frameworks behind Netflix's AI Observability platform, model performance, evaluation, and vendor integration surfaces. You will design reusable infrastructure that enables ML/AI practitioners across domains to monitor model quality in production, evaluate LLM and agentic systems, and adopt vendor tooling through a consistent, self-serve platform. AIP owns the generic, reusable infrastructure; domain teams own their domain-specific evals and remediation. You will partner closely with engineering, product, machine learning, and data teams to turn their needs into reusable platform capabilities. To succeed, you will bring a strong background in AI or ML infrastructure and a passion for building scalable, robust systems.

In this role, you will:

•
Build the observability framework and platform capabilities that give ML and GenAI systems metrics, logs, and distributed traces across online inference, batch scoring, feature pipelines, and agent orchestration, so teams can instrument their systems consistently.

•
Build the primitives that let teams monitor model performance (accuracy, calibration, error rates), data quality, drift, and degradation on their own systems, rather than monitoring individual models yourself.

•
Build and extend evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic systems that support response quality, grounding and hallucination, task success, tool-use and trajectory correctness, and LLM-as-a-judge and human-in-the-loop scoring, giving teams reusable building blocks to define and run their own evals.

•
Lead build-vs-buy evaluations for observability and eval tooling, and own the SDKs, connectors, and APIs that integrate vendor platforms into a consistent, well-supported interface, so ML and product teams can onboard models and agents with minimal friction.

•
Build reusable libraries, SDKs, and templates that make observability and evaluation the default for new systems ("observability-by-default"), lowering the barrier for teams to instrument and evaluate their work.

•
Provide the dashboarding, alerting, and SLO/SLI building blocks (plus sensible out-of-the-box templates) that teams use to track model performance, latency, cost, and reliability.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

•
Experience in software, AI/ML, or platform engineering, with hands-on time in production observability, monitoring, or ML/LLM evaluation

•
Proven track record of designing standards, libraries, SDKs, or frameworks that other teams build on and adopt, reflecting a platform and enablement mindset rather than shipping features for a single use case.

•
Strong coding skills in Python and at least one of Java, Go, or Scala, with experience building production services

•
Practical experience operating ML models in production (online serving and/or batch), including drift, model performance, and data quality.

•
Hands-on experience with modern observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, Jaeger/Tempo, or similar).

•
Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

•
Ability to work cross-functionally with ML, data, infra, and product teams, and to communicate clearly about system behavior, quality, and risk.

•
Experience with vendor integration and VPC deployment.

•
AI-Native Engineering Mindset who uses AI tools as a core part of their own workflow to accelerate design, development, testing, and code review.

Nice to have:

•
Hands-on experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation tools (e.g., Arize, Braintrust, LangFuse, Weights & Biases, Galileo, Vertex AI Model Monitoring, SageMaker Model Monitor).

•
Experience building or shipping LLM/GenAI applications and evaluating them: prompt/result logging, evaluation metrics, LLM-as-a-judge, and human-in-the-loop review.

•
Experience evaluating agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, and trajectory/task-success measurement.

title: Language Producer, Content Localization, CEE
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Content Localization team, responsible for dubbing, subtitling, accessibility, main/episodic titles, and marketing assets, plays a crucial role in delivering these programs to an expanding international audience by focusing on high-quality localized audio and text services, fostering a collaborative team environment, and utilizing technology.

As a Language Producer, you will ensure that members experience high-quality localized assets, preserving creative intent and enhancing the localized experience for viewers everywhere. With Netflix's global reach and ever-evolving entertainment footprint, localization support for new languages and content genres is essential to our success, making this an exciting time to join the company.

The Role

The Language Producer is the advocate for language quality, creative consistency, and cultural authenticity across all localized Netflix content in their assigned language(s). This role oversees the end-to-end creative and linguistic aspects of dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets, serving as the key point of contact for all language-specific localization efforts. Approximately 40% of the role is dedicated to direct title and project coverage—supporting long-form project progress, creative strategy and quality control, and the launch of all localized assets—while the remaining 60% focuses on strategic market and talent development, including workflow innovation, vendor management, and building a robust talent pipeline. This is in support and collaboration with Content Localization Title Producers. The Language Producer partners with internal teams and external talent to deliver high-quality, culturally relevant content. By monitoring language trends and maintaining deep market awareness, this role ensures every Netflix story resonates authentically with local audiences and upholds high standards of creative excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Language Quality & Creative Excellence

•
Establish and enforce creative and quality standards and guidelines for all localized content in your assigned language(s), ensuring consistency across dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets.

•
Develop, implement, and maintain language strategies that prioritize localization efforts based on business impact and creative requirements.

•
Monitor language performance metrics and emerging linguistic trends, proactively identifying and resolving quality or consistency challenges.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Advocacy

•
Partner closely with Content Localization Title Producers, Product Localization, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to align on localization strategy, execution, and creative direction for your language(s).

•
Represent language-specific needs and perspectives in cross-team initiatives, integration projects, and support for emerging media types.

•
Ensure effective communication channels between local language teams and global stakeholders, advocating for both local nuance and global consistency.

Vendor & Resource Management

•
Inform the consolidation and strategic assignment of vendors at the language level to maximize efficiency, quality, and scalability.

•
Collaborate with Global Resource Management to evaluate, refine, and implement vendor strategies and resource allocation for your language(s).

•
Oversee the selection, onboarding, and ongoing management of language-specific resources, ensuring a strong talent pipeline.

Talent & Market Engagement

•
Build and maintain strong relationships with local dubbing and subtitling talent, studios, and industry communities to support creative excellence and market relevance.

•
Maintain and regularly update a database of language talent in partnership with vendors, performance, and specialization.

•
Monitor union, guild, and competitor activity to anticipate market shifts, inform strategy, and maintain competitive talent engagement.

Innovation, Change & Scalability

•
Serve as the local Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Netflix tooling and workflows, providing guidance to vendors on effective adoption, troubleshooting, and best practices to ensure seamless integration and operational excellence.

•
Champion the adoption of new workflows, automation, and technology to streamline localization processes and support the localization of emerging media types (e.g., interactive, live, podcasts).

•
Lead initiatives to enhance quality at scale, expedite project timelines, and support business continuity across all content types and workflows.

•
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging experimentation and the sharing of best practices within the local industry.

Inclusion & Diversity

•
Lead and support initiatives to ensure inclusive and diverse engagement of language talent and resources.

•
Ensure that localization strategies and talent pipelines reflect both the nuances of local audiences and the broader goals of global consistency and representation.

•
Champion global diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts in language production.

Minimum Qualifications

•
5 or more years of experience in content localization, dubbing, subtitle, or international versioning for TV/film services.

•
Expertise in both dubbing and subtitling workflows, with a strong passion for language quality and cultural nuance.

•
Ability to handle a fast-paced environment, supervising several projects at various points of production (from development through delivery).

•
Linguistic expertise and previous localization experience in your local market language(s).

•
Understanding of localization workflows, tools, and best practices, with a track record of delivering high-quality language assets at scale.

•
Effective communication and relationship-building skills; able to work effectively in collaboration with creative, operational, and technical teams.

•
Ability to make independent decisions and navigate evolving priorities.

•
Analytical and solutions-oriented approach; able to identify root causes, optimize processes, and drive operational excellence.

•
Fluency in English and Polish required.

•
Willingness to travel as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Experience with accessibility standards (SDH, Audio Description) and emerging media formats.

•
Fluency in Czech and/or Hungarian.

title: Software Engineer 6 - Ads Account Foundations
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and we are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

•
Core Accounts: We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

•
Account Intelligence: We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

•
Account Cohort and Verification Automation: Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

•
Spend Attribution: We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

•
7+ years of experience building cloud-based applications with modern programming languages

•
4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

•
Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

•
Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

•
Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

•
Familiarity with Object/Entity lifecycle management and data governance associated with it.

•
Operational excellence experience with customer-facing APIs, including SLO tracking, incident management, and observability tooling,

•
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

•
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Nice to haves:

•
Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g  VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

•
Working knowledge of AI/ML/genAI techniques and an ability to apply them to the account management lifecycle or API reliability monitoring.

•
Early experience with customer-facing MCP concerns, such as defining tools contracts,  security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration), and integration with other AI agents.

•
Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

Build and Lead Conversation

•
Grow and nurture the most engaged OTT community in India.

Drive always-on cultural presence beyond Title launches

Ensure Netflix India consistently leads monthly share of voice and shapes how titles travel across press and KOL ecosystems.

•
Mine real-time audience feedback, sentiment, and heat signals.

•
Identify breakout moments early and course-correct underperformance fast.

Represent the audience voice in internal forums and influence marketing pivots.

You are both a cultural antenna and a performance radar.

•
Show up meaningfully across festivals, cultural flashpoints, and everyday usage moments.

Create and scale social IP that reinforces Netflix's personality.

Work with creators for relevance and credibility, not transactional reach.

Bring a programmer's instinct to social — know which stories, scenes, and moments from our slate are worth amplifying, and when, across a title's entire lifecycle.

Own reactive excellence and boosting strategy to maximize cultural impact.

Partner with creators, collaborators, and ecosystem players to widen footprint.

Strong narrative thinker who understands how social shapes perception.

Language Quality & Creative Excellence

Establish and enforce creative and quality standards and guidelines for all localized content in your assigned language(s), ensuring consistency across dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets.

Develop, implement, and maintain language strategies that prioritize localization efforts based on business impact and creative requirements.

Monitor language performance metrics and emerging linguistic trends, proactively identifying and resolving quality or consistency challenges.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Advocacy

Represent language-specific needs and perspectives in cross-team initiatives, integration projects, and support for emerging media types.

Ensure effective communication channels between local language teams and global stakeholders, advocating for both local nuance and global consistency.

Vendor & Resource Management

Inform the consolidation and strategic assignment of vendors at the language level to maximize efficiency, quality, and scalability.

•
Collaborate with Global Resource Management to evaluate, refine, and implement vendor strategies and resource allocation for your language(s).

Oversee the selection, onboarding, and ongoing management of language-specific resources, ensuring a strong talent pipeline.

Talent & Market Engagement

Build and maintain strong relationships with local dubbing and subtitling talent, studios, and industry communities to support creative excellence and market relevance.

•
Maintain and regularly update a database of language talent in partnership with vendors, performance, and specialization.

•
Monitor union, guild, and competitor activity to anticipate market shifts, inform strategy, and maintain competitive talent engagement.

Innovation, Change & Scalability

Serve as the local Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Netflix tooling and workflows, providing guidance to vendors on effective adoption, troubleshooting, and best practices to ensure seamless integration and operational excellence.

Champion the adoption of new workflows, automation, and technology to streamline localization processes and support the localization of emerging media types (e.g., interactive, live, podcasts).

Lead initiatives to enhance quality at scale, expedite project timelines, and support business continuity across all content types and workflows.

Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging experimentation and the sharing of best practices within the local industry.
