Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging experimentation and the sharing of best practices within the local industry.

5 or more years of experience in content localization, dubbing, subtitle, or international versioning for TV/film services.

Expertise in both dubbing and subtitling workflows, with a strong passion for language quality and cultural nuance.

•
Ability to handle a fast-paced environment, supervising several projects at various points of production (from development through delivery).

•
Linguistic expertise and previous localization experience in your local market language(s).

Understanding of localization workflows, tools, and best practices, with a track record of delivering high-quality language assets at scale.

Effective communication and relationship-building skills; able to work effectively in collaboration with creative, operational, and technical teams.

Ability to make independent decisions and navigate evolving priorities.

Analytical and solutions-oriented approach; able to identify root causes, optimize processes, and drive operational excellence.

Fluency in English and Polish required.

Willingness to travel as needed.

Experience with accessibility standards (SDH, Audio Description) and emerging media formats.

Fluency in Czech and/or Hungarian.

description:

Our Team

The Ads Platform team builds the advertising systems and integrations that powers the delivery of ads using our world class content delivery ecosystem. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving, members only see the most appropriate ads for them and Netflix’s advertising policies and contracts are thoroughly enforced.

Our team is faced with the ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Product Operations team sits inside the Netflix Advertising team and owns the operating layer for Product, often bridging the boundary to Engineering and Design teams. Our team focuses on: How work gets prioritized, how decisions get made and tracked, and how teams stay aligned as the ads business scales. The team designs and maintains the frameworks, tooling, and artifacts that keep that organization running, and is now extending that mandate to agentic AI as core operational infrastructure.

The Ads Product Operations team is searching for a technical, operational expert who is highly organized and execution-driven in the product management space. You bring deep curiosity and hands-on proficiency with agentic tools, and a strong sense of ownership for driving successful operational practices.

Enable the agentic transformation of the product development lifecycle as part of the Product Operations team.

Modernize the core components of the lifecycle (discovery, planning, ideation, validation, and engineering collaboration) through agentic leverage.

Author, ship, and maintain the plugins, skills, and integrations that product teams use every day.

Land AI proficiency across the product organization through onboarding, hands-on labs, office hours, reusable enablement content, and a network of power users and champions.

Evaluate agentic plugin and skill efficacy on an ongoing basis, monitor for drift as the underlying models evolve, and consolidate, refresh, or retire tooling accordingly.

Steward the operating frameworks the organization runs on, keeping standards clear, reporting trustworthy, and work transparent across Product and Engineering.

Partner with Product Management, TPM, Engineering, Data Science, Design, and XD to embed agentic practice into everyday product work.

8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product/Program Management, Software Engineering, Engineering Operations, or a closely related discipline, with a track record of operational change programs that measurably shifted how teams work.

•
Deep understanding of how product managers and engineering teams collaborate, where the lifecycle breaks down, and what good looks like in an Enterprise B2B product environment.

•
Working proficiency with GitHub and Git workflows (branches, pull requests, code review, versioned collaboration), with enough technical fluency to read code, follow an architecture conversation, and reason about APIs and data.

•
Demonstrated proficiency with modern agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or comparable) and mult-agent workflows as core daily infrastructure rather than a novelty. You use these tools to do your own work solving real problems and build scalable systems, not just to evaluate them.

Deep curiosity about the fast-moving AI landscape with a focus on productivity and solving business problems: you track developments from AI labs, practitioners, and experts, and bring ideas back to the team to fold into how we operate.

•
Hands-on experience authoring agentic capability beyond prompting: skills, plugins, agents, or equivalent.

•
Working fluency in the systems and data infrastructure involved in how AI agents consume and act on content (embeddings, RAG, retrieval quality, context windows, prompt design), enough to collaborate with engineering partners.

•
Experience defining and applying evals and quality benchmarks for agentic capabilities and iterating based on measured outcomes.

•
Proven ability to drive organizational change through hands-on enablement, advocacy, and the instrumentation to prove it landed: defining metrics, standing up reporting, and distinguishing activity from outcome.

Strong judgment about where automation and process belongs, applying process to the outcomes that benefit from it rather than defaulting to it, with the credibility to hold that line with stakeholders.

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and influence across Product, Engineering, and executive audiences.

Proven ability to operate as an individual contributor, driving outcomes independently and influencing cross-functional teams (especially PM and Eng) without direct authority.

Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

This is not just a community manager role.

This is not about posting calendars and managing handles.

This is internet marketing at a cultural scale.

We're looking for a cultural operator. A conversation hacker. A genuine content obsessive. Someone who understands the Indian internet deeply, watches everything, and knows how to turn moments into movements. You're as creative as you are analytical — as comfortable pitching a wild idea as you are reading a content slate and knowing exactly which title deserves the internet's attention this week. Loves content coming from different regions in India - Hindi and South. Social at Netflix is a growth engine, an intelligence system, and a brand love machine. If you can balance instinct with insight and culture with craft, this is your playground.

The Mandate

Build and Lead Conversation

•
Grow and nurture the most engaged OTT community in India.

•
Drive always-on cultural presence beyond Title launches

•
Ensure Netflix India consistently leads monthly share of voice and shapes how titles travel across press and KOL ecosystems.

Turn Social into Strategic Intelligence

•
Mine real-time audience feedback, sentiment, and heat signals.

•
Identify breakout moments early and course-correct underperformance fast.

•
Represent the audience voice in internal forums and influence marketing pivots.

You are both a cultural antenna and a performance radar.

Build Brand Love Through Culture

•
Show up meaningfully across festivals, cultural flashpoints, and everyday usage moments.

•
Create and scale social IP that reinforces Netflix's personality.

•
Work with creators for relevance and credibility, not transactional reach.

•
Bring a programmer's instinct to social — know which stories, scenes, and moments from our slate are worth amplifying, and when, across a title's entire lifecycle.

Drive Cross-Functional Impact

•
Work closely with internal teams and marcomms partners to ensure strong ownership on campaigns; align with cross-functional efforts led by Content, Brand, FSM, Publicity, Comms, Product, Partnerships and other teams.

•
Co-own tentpole brand beats across the year.

•
Own reactive excellence and boosting strategy to maximize cultural impact.

Expand Beyond Owned Handles

•
Recognize that the next wave of growth sits beyond metro-heavy legacy communities.

•
Partner with creators, collaborators, and ecosystem players to widen footprint.

Who You Are

•
8 to 10+ years of experience in social marketing, having worked in the entertainment industry, network/studio marketing, global lifestyle / digital-first brands, or a creative agency (experience in the entertainment category preferred).

•
Deep fluency in Indian internet behavior across cohorts and regions.

•
A genuinely creative mind — someone who concepts, not just executes; who pitches ideas that make a room go quiet.

•
Real content programming instincts — you read a slate, know how to sequence conversation around a title's lifecycle, and can spot what's culturally primed to travel before anyone else does.

•
An obsessive, personal love of content — you watch everything, have opinions on everything, and that excitement shows up in the work.

•
Able to balance creative instinct with data-led decision making.

•
Comfortable operating in ambiguity with high ownership.

•
Strong narrative thinker who understands how social shapes perception.

Why This Role Matters

At Netflix India, social does not amplify culture. It actively shapes it.

You will influence what trends, what headlines travel, how fandoms form, and how Netflix shows up in everyday conversation across India.

If you want to build cultural momentum, not just manage feeds, we would love to hear from you.

Keep Glowbot (the team's project-tracking system) current and support ongoing efforts to automate manual admin work.

•
Partner cross-functionally with Publicity, Events, Post Production, and Awards on timing, asset readiness, and market-specific requirements (e.g. classification, versioning).

•
Build and manage vendor relationships across APAC, ensuring reliance on vendors; while helping diversify and strengthen the local vendor bench in each country.

•
Serve as the primary screening project point of contact, navigating language, quality, delivery and stakeholder complexity independently.

Requirements - Must Have

•
Strong project and time management, including composure under reactive, short-notice timelines.

•
Comfortable operating independently in-market; will often be the only Screenings presence in India day to day.

Cross-functional collaboration skills: this role sits at the intersection of Publicity, Events, and Post Production and needs to build trust with all three.

Stakeholder & Reputation Management: SME support for cross-functional enquiries; filmmaker/executive alignment on sensitive quality conversations.

High attention to detail and an excellence bar suited to premiere-level, talent-facing events.

Vendor Relationship Management: setting and enforcing service-level expectations with vendors and engineering contractors.

•
Admin: expense tracking, vendor payment system setup, Glowbot access setup.

Willing to travel.

•
Hands-on technical experience in DCI (Digital Cinema Initiatives) and AV: DCP, QC, tech check, and KDM technical understanding, plus real-time pass/fail judgment on site.

On-Site Execution: technical producing, day-of-event communication management, on-site vendor accountability.

•
Ability to read and enforce precise digital cinema equipment calibration standards.

•
Business acumen and a "quality gatekeeper" mindset, treating technical execution as a strategic contribution to campaign and awards outcomes, not just delivery.

•
Experience building or managing vendor relationships from scratch in a market, especially valuable given India's current vendor concentration risk.

•
Familiarity with festival or awards-season logistics.

•
Regional Operations: proven ability to manage multi-country logistics independently and adapt to local venue/market conditions.

Screenings run smoothly and on-brand across all APAC markets; vendor relationships are proactively managed and diversified; and cross-functional partners see Screenings as a trusted, strategic partner, not just a technical service.

title: Language Producer, Content Localization, CEE
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Content Localization team, responsible for dubbing, subtitling, accessibility, main/episodic titles, and marketing assets, plays a crucial role in delivering these programs to an expanding international audience by focusing on high-quality localized audio and text services, fostering a collaborative team environment, and utilizing technology.

As a Language Producer, you will ensure that members experience high-quality localized assets, preserving creative intent and enhancing the localized experience for viewers everywhere. With Netflix's global reach and ever-evolving entertainment footprint, localization support for new languages and content genres is essential to our success, making this an exciting time to join the company.

The Role

The Language Producer is the advocate for language quality, creative consistency, and cultural authenticity across all localized Netflix content in their assigned language(s). This role oversees the end-to-end creative and linguistic aspects of dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets, serving as the key point of contact for all language-specific localization efforts. Approximately 40% of the role is dedicated to direct title and project coverage—supporting long-form project progress, creative strategy and quality control, and the launch of all localized assets—while the remaining 60% focuses on strategic market and talent development, including workflow innovation, vendor management, and building a robust talent pipeline. This is in support and collaboration with Content Localization Title Producers. The Language Producer partners with internal teams and external talent to deliver high-quality, culturally relevant content. By monitoring language trends and maintaining deep market awareness, this role ensures every Netflix story resonates authentically with local audiences and upholds high standards of creative excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Language Quality & Creative Excellence

•
Establish and enforce creative and quality standards and guidelines for all localized content in your assigned language(s), ensuring consistency across dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets.

•
Develop, implement, and maintain language strategies that prioritize localization efforts based on business impact and creative requirements.

•
Monitor language performance metrics and emerging linguistic trends, proactively identifying and resolving quality or consistency challenges.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Advocacy

•
Partner closely with Content Localization Title Producers, Product Localization, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to align on localization strategy, execution, and creative direction for your language(s).

•
Represent language-specific needs and perspectives in cross-team initiatives, integration projects, and support for emerging media types.

•
Ensure effective communication channels between local language teams and global stakeholders, advocating for both local nuance and global consistency.

Vendor & Resource Management

•
Inform the consolidation and strategic assignment of vendors at the language level to maximize efficiency, quality, and scalability.

•
Collaborate with Global Resource Management to evaluate, refine, and implement vendor strategies and resource allocation for your language(s).

•
Oversee the selection, onboarding, and ongoing management of language-specific resources, ensuring a strong talent pipeline.

Talent & Market Engagement

•
Build and maintain strong relationships with local dubbing and subtitling talent, studios, and industry communities to support creative excellence and market relevance.

•
Maintain and regularly update a database of language talent in partnership with vendors, performance, and specialization.

•
Monitor union, guild, and competitor activity to anticipate market shifts, inform strategy, and maintain competitive talent engagement.

Innovation, Change & Scalability

•
Serve as the local Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Netflix tooling and workflows, providing guidance to vendors on effective adoption, troubleshooting, and best practices to ensure seamless integration and operational excellence.

•
Champion the adoption of new workflows, automation, and technology to streamline localization processes and support the localization of emerging media types (e.g., interactive, live, podcasts).

•
Lead initiatives to enhance quality at scale, expedite project timelines, and support business continuity across all content types and workflows.

•
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging experimentation and the sharing of best practices within the local industry.

Inclusion & Diversity

•
Lead and support initiatives to ensure inclusive and diverse engagement of language talent and resources.

•
Ensure that localization strategies and talent pipelines reflect both the nuances of local audiences and the broader goals of global consistency and representation.

•
Champion global diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts in language production.

Minimum Qualifications

•
5 or more years of experience in content localization, dubbing, subtitle, or international versioning for TV/film services.

•
Expertise in both dubbing and subtitling workflows, with a strong passion for language quality and cultural nuance.

•
Ability to handle a fast-paced environment, supervising several projects at various points of production (from development through delivery).

•
Linguistic expertise and previous localization experience in your local market language(s).

•
Understanding of localization workflows, tools, and best practices, with a track record of delivering high-quality language assets at scale.

•
Effective communication and relationship-building skills; able to work effectively in collaboration with creative, operational, and technical teams.

•
Ability to make independent decisions and navigate evolving priorities.

•
Analytical and solutions-oriented approach; able to identify root causes, optimize processes, and drive operational excellence.

•
Fluency in English and Polish required.

•
Willingness to travel as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Experience with accessibility standards (SDH, Audio Description) and emerging media formats.

•
Fluency in Czech and/or Hungarian.

description:

The Opportunity

As an Associate – Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India.

This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy—partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery.

You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success.

What You'll Do

Partner with Productions

•
Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production.

Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.

Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts.

•
Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early.

•
Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections.

•
Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions.

•
Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance.

Deliver Meaningful Insights

•
Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies.

•
Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations.

•
Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.

Strengthen Financial Operations

•
Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.

•
Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.

•
Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.

•
Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers—you want to understand the story behind them.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

•
7+ years of experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Production Management, or a similar role within the film, television, or media industry.

•
Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.

•
Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.

•
Excellent financial analysis and problem-solving skills with strong business judgment.

•
Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with production accounting software is an advantage.

•
Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting systems is preferred.

•
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.

•
Exceptional attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture.

•
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

Who You Are

•
You thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.

•
You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.

•
You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.

•
You balance analytical thinking with practical decision-making.

•
You have high standards, strong integrity, and a commitment to excellence.

•
You're passionate about entertainment and excited to help bring incredible stories to audiences around the world.

Why Netflix?

At Netflix, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting productions in the industry while partnering with exceptionally talented people across creative, production, and business teams.

You'll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from day one, encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, and empowered to make an impact on how world-class stories are produced.

If you're excited by the idea of combining finance, strategy, and storytelling, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Software Engineer 6 - Ads Account Foundations
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and we are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

•
Core Accounts: We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

•
Account Intelligence: We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

•
Account Cohort and Verification Automation: Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

•
Spend Attribution: We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

•
Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

•
Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

•
Familiarity with Object/Entity lifecycle management and data governance associated with it.

•
Operational excellence experience with customer-facing APIs, including SLO tracking, incident management, and observability tooling,

•
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

•
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

•
Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g  VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

Working knowledge of AI/ML/genAI techniques and an ability to apply them to the account management lifecycle or API reliability monitoring.

Drive always-on cultural presence beyond Title launches

Identify breakout moments early and course-correct underperformance fast.

Represent the audience voice in internal forums and influence marketing pivots.

Partner with creators, collaborators, and ecosystem players to widen footprint.

description:

The Role

The Language Producer is the advocate for language quality, creative consistency, and cultural authenticity across all localized Netflix content in their assigned language(s). This is in support and collaboration with Content Localization Title Producers. The Language Producer partners with internal teams and external talent to deliver high-quality, culturally relevant content. By monitoring language trends and maintaining deep market awareness, this role ensures every Netflix story resonates authentically with local audiences and upholds high standards of creative excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Language Quality & Creative Excellence

•
Establish and enforce creative and quality standards and guidelines for all localized content in your assigned language(s), ensuring consistency across dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets.

•
Develop, implement, and maintain language strategies that prioritize localization efforts based on business impact and creative requirements.

•
Monitor language performance metrics and emerging linguistic trends, proactively identifying and resolving quality or consistency challenges.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Advocacy

•
Partner closely with Content Localization Title Producers, Product Localization, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to align on localization strategy, execution, and creative direction for your language(s).

•
Represent language-specific needs and perspectives in cross-team initiatives, integration projects, and support for emerging media types.

•
Ensure effective communication channels between local language teams and global stakeholders, advocating for both local nuance and global consistency.

Vendor & Resource Management

•
Inform the consolidation and strategic assignment of vendors at the language level to maximize efficiency, quality, and scalability.

•
Collaborate with Global Resource Management to evaluate, refine, and implement vendor strategies and resource allocation for your language(s).

•
Oversee the selection, onboarding, and ongoing management of language-specific resources, ensuring a strong talent pipeline.

Talent & Market Engagement

•
Build and maintain strong relationships with local dubbing and subtitling talent, studios, and industry communities to support creative excellence and market relevance.

•
Maintain and regularly update a database of language talent in partnership with vendors, performance, and specialization.

•
Monitor union, guild, and competitor activity to anticipate market shifts, inform strategy, and maintain competitive talent engagement.

Innovation, Change & Scalability

•
Serve as the local Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Netflix tooling and workflows, providing guidance to vendors on effective adoption, troubleshooting, and best practices to ensure seamless integration and operational excellence.

•
Champion the adoption of new workflows, automation, and technology to streamline localization processes and support the localization of emerging media types (e.g., interactive, live, podcasts).

•
Lead initiatives to enhance quality at scale, expedite project timelines, and support business continuity across all content types and workflows.

•
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging experimentation and the sharing of best practices within the local industry.

Inclusion & Diversity

•
Champion global diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts in language production.

Minimum Qualifications

•
5 or more years of experience in content localization, dubbing, subtitle, or international versioning for TV/film services.

•
Expertise in both dubbing and subtitling workflows, with a strong passion for language quality and cultural nuance.

•
Ability to handle a fast-paced environment, supervising several projects at various points of production (from development through delivery).

•
Linguistic expertise and previous localization experience in your local market language(s).

•
Understanding of localization workflows, tools, and best practices, with a track record of delivering high-quality language assets at scale.

•
Effective communication and relationship-building skills; able to work effectively in collaboration with creative, operational, and technical teams.

•
Ability to make independent decisions and navigate evolving priorities.

•
Analytical and solutions-oriented approach; able to identify root causes, optimize processes, and drive operational excellence.

Fluency in English and Polish required.

Experience with accessibility standards (SDH, Audio Description) and emerging media formats.

Fluency in Czech and/or Hungarian.

Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.

Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.

Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.

•
Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.

Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.

Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.

Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.

You thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.

•
You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.

•
You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.

•
You balance analytical thinking with practical decision-making.

title: Software Engineer 6 - Ads Account Foundations
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and we are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

•
Core Accounts: We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

•
Account Intelligence: We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

•
Account Cohort and Verification Automation: Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

•
Spend Attribution: We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

•
7+ years of experience building cloud-based applications with modern programming languages

•
4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

•
Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

•
Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

•
Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

•
Familiarity with Object/Entity lifecycle management and data governance associated with it.

•
Operational excellence experience with customer-facing APIs, including SLO tracking, incident management, and observability tooling,

•
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

•
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Expertise in both dubbing and subtitling workflows, with a strong passion for language quality and cultural nuance.

Ability to handle a fast-paced environment, supervising several projects at various points of production (from development through delivery).

Effective communication and relationship-building skills; able to work effectively in collaboration with creative, operational, and technical teams.

title: Lead UX Designer - Games
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Who We Are

From games on TV to mobile and web, Next Games is a Netflix first-party studio that develops approachable games to entertain a diverse, global audience.

We design games that Netflix members can enjoy every day as part of their subscription. Our games released on Netflix to date include TV games Boggle Party, Pictionary Game Night, Party Crashers: Fool Your Friends, and Underwatermelon, as well as Netflix Puzzled, available on mobile devices and on tudum.com.

We proudly combine our Finnish game development culture with Netflix's global entertainment culture, embracing the strengths of both and empowering our talented and diverse teams to deliver their best work yet.

The Role

As a Lead UX Designer, you will help create high-quality games that are playable, enjoyable, and accessible to a broad audience. In this role, you will work closely with your team daily and develop and execute a strategic UX vision for each of our games, demonstrating a deep understanding of our audience and their needs as players.

You will maintain consistent relationships with players and provide valuable insights to the team, enabling a player-centric approach to improving game features and iterations. Your excellent communication skills and strong sense of teamwork make you a supportive collaborator. You are passionate about accessibility, with years of experience advocating for best practices and championing inclusive design. As the studio’s accessibility expert, you will lead accessibility efforts, mentor your team, and ensure our games are welcoming to all players.

Responsibilities

•
Guide the team through all steps of the UX process to holistically improve the game experience.

•
Design accessible, usable, and enjoyable UX for a broad, casual audience, defining game communication, structure, and content strategy.

•
Champion accessibility as the studio expert: lead best practices, facilitate workshops, and ensure guidelines are current and implemented.

•
Manage, mentor, and support team members, fostering growth in UX and accessibility.

•
Apply scientific methods and Design Thinking to UX research, testing, and feature development, ensuring data-driven decisions.

•
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (UX researchers, UI artists, designers, artists, leads, stakeholders) to enhance processes and game quality.

•
Advocate for players through direct community engagement and sharing insights to inform design.

•
Develop and maintain frameworks for heuristic evaluation and share clear, polished documentation.

Skills and Abilities

•
Proven experience designing for both web and app platforms, taking features from concept through implementation.

•
Expertise in accessibility and inclusive design, including running accessibility tests and leading workshops.

•
Strong foundation in scientific UX research methods, including hypothesis testing, experimental design, and data analysis.

•
Ability to design game architecture, flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes (Figma).

•
Experience with user research tools (e.g., PlaytestCloud) and basic Unity skills.

•
Excellent visual design, communication, leadership, and mentoring abilities.

•
Commitment to player-centric, collaborative, and iterative development.

•
Skilled in creating and maintaining thorough documentation and advancing UX maturity within the team.

The Team

You’ll join a diverse studio environment, working primarily from our Helsinki office. We value transparent communication, proactive problem-solving, and enthusiasm for crafting accessible experiences. As the Lead UX Designer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our player experiences at Next Games.

title: Associate, Production Finance - India
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Behind every great story is a team of people enabling creators to do their best work. Our Production Finance team partners with filmmakers and production partners to bring Netflix Originals to life while ensuring financial excellence, operational rigor, and responsible stewardship of production investments.

If you're passionate about storytelling, love solving complex business problems, and thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments, we'd love to meet you.

The Opportunity

As an Associate – Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India.

This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy—partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery.

You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success.

What You'll Do

Partner with Productions

•
Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production.

•
Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.

•
Support production partners by providing guidance on Netflix's financial policies, reporting expectations, and production finance processes.

Drive Financial Excellence

•
Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts.

•
Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early.

•
Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections.

•
Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions.

•
Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance.

Deliver Meaningful Insights

•
Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies.

•
Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations.

•
Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.

Strengthen Financial Operations

•
Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.

•
Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.

•
Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.

•
Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers—you want to understand the story behind them.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

•
7+ years of experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Production Management, or a similar role within the film, television, or media industry.

•
Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.

•
Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.

•
Excellent financial analysis and problem-solving skills with strong business judgment.

•
Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with production accounting software is an advantage.

•
Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting systems is preferred.

•
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.

•
Exceptional attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture.

•
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

Who You Are

•
You thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.

•
You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.

•
You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.

•
You balance analytical thinking with practical decision-making.

•
You have high standards, strong integrity, and a commitment to excellence.

•
You're passionate about entertainment and excited to help bring incredible stories to audiences around the world.

Why Netflix?

At Netflix, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting productions in the industry while partnering with exceptionally talented people across creative, production, and business teams.

You'll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from day one, encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, and empowered to make an impact on how world-class stories are produced.

If you're excited by the idea of combining finance, strategy, and storytelling, we'd love to hear from you.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and we are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

•
Core Accounts: We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

•
Account Intelligence: We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

•
Account Cohort and Verification Automation: Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

•
Spend Attribution: We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

•
7+ years of experience building cloud-based applications with modern programming languages

•
4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

•
Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

•
Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

•
Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

•
Familiarity with Object/Entity lifecycle management and data governance associated with it.

•
Operational excellence experience with customer-facing APIs, including SLO tracking, incident management, and observability tooling,

•
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

•
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Nice to haves:

•
Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g  VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

•
Working knowledge of AI/ML/genAI techniques and an ability to apply them to the account management lifecycle or API reliability monitoring.

•
Early experience with customer-facing MCP concerns, such as defining tools contracts,  security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration), and integration with other AI agents.

•
Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

title: Head of Character Effects (CFX) - Netflix Animation Studios
description:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Head of Character Effects (CFX) to support our upcoming animated feature film. The Head of Character Effects works inside of NAS as the show-based leader for all character-related secondary motion, including hair, fur, feathers, cloth, and garments. They will partner closely with the Director, Production Designer, VFX Supervisor, Art Director, Head of Characters, Head of Character Animation and Technical Supervisor to ensure that character effects are both artistically compelling and technically robust.

The Head of Character Effects will oversee the CFX team during asset development, look development, and shot production. They will define the simulation approach for the show, review and give notes on all CFX work, and ensure it meets the highest quality bar while remaining efficient and stable in production. This may involve developing or supervising prototypes, guiding grooming and garment construction for simulation, solving complex technical problems, and helping to set up the CFX side of the project for success.

This position is essential in bridging the gap between creative intent and simulation-driven workflows, ensuring that character motion feels alive, expressive, and fully aligned with the film’s visual language. The Head of Character Effects builds strong relationships with creative leadership and with technical and production partners, demonstrating great diplomatic and interpersonal skills to balance artistic ambition with schedule and pipeline constraints.

What You’ll Do:

•
Lead and supervise Character Effects across the show, from look development to final shot delivery

•
Define the creative and technical approach for hair, fur, cloth, feathers, and other character-related simulations

•
Review CFX assets and shots, providing clear, actionable artistic and technical notes

•
Collaborate with Directors, Production Designers, Art Directors, Head of Characters, Animation, FX, and Look Development to ensure CFX supports character performance and story

•
Partner with Technical Supervisors, Production Technology, and R&D to develop and maintain robust, efficient CFX tools and workflows

•
Anticipate and identify creative and technical challenges in CFX and offer practical, innovative solutions

•
Work with Production Management on bids, schedules, and priorities to deliver high-quality work on time and within scope

•
Mentor and support CFX Supervisors, Leads, and Artists, fostering growth, clarity, and a positive team culture

•
Communicate effectively across disciplines, translating complex technical concepts into accessible language for creative partners

•
Collaborate with grace, humility, inclusion, and open-mindedness

What You’ll Need:

•
At least 10 years of experience in Character Effects/FX within film, TV, or games, including 5–7 years in leadership or supervisory roles on large-scale animated features or VFX films

•
Proven, production-level expertise in Houdini (SOPs/DOPs/POPs), with strong understanding of cloth, hair, fur, feather, and soft-body simulations; muscle/skin experience is a plus

•
Strong scripting and/or programming skills (e.g., Python, VEX) and familiarity with Linux-based workflows

•
Deep understanding of the end-to-end 3D animation pipeline and how CFX interacts with Modeling, Grooming, Rigging, Surfacing, Animation, FX, Lighting, and Compositing

•
A strong eye for movement, weight, and anatomy, and the ability to give clear, constructive notes that improve performance and appeal

•
Excellent leadership, communication, and mentoring skills, with the ability to build trust and enthusiasm across a cross-site team while fostering a respectful, collaborative, and inclusive environment.

title: VFX Supervisor - Netflix Animation Studios
description:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:

The VFX Supervisor will oversee all things CG on the project, including the creative and technical execution of the film across all CG departments from assets through final delivery. They will partner with the Technical Supervisor to define the workflows and technical solutions to successfully achieve the creative requirements and artistic goals of the production.  They will work with Department Heads, Technical and Creative leadership teams to ensure that story and design assets are functioning from a technical standpoint and that CG work meets the desired visual quality and consistency.

Our ideal candidate blends deep technical knowledge with applied hands‑on CG experience. They are a natural problem solver and a clear communicator who can collaborate effectively across creative, technical, and production disciplines.

What You’ll Do

•
Partner with the Director and Production Designer to implement their creative vision, providing technical oversight on CG complexity and feasibility to deliver the project on schedule and budget.

•
Guide and align Heads of Department and Supervisors (Animation, Characters, Environments, CFX, Effects, Layout, Lighting, Compositing, etc.) in their approach to achieving the Director’s vision for the film

•
Review CG work in progress from various departments to ensure the creative brief has been met, the work is on‑style, and that creative and technical standards are upheld

•
Help define and oversee CG workflows and technical solutions in partnership with the Technical Supervisor and pipeline/TD teams

•
Work flexibly and with a positive attitude to troubleshoot and address creative and technical notes from filmmakers and Production, providing practical solutions

•
Provide an open dialogue with Production Management on any potential roadblocks, bottlenecks, or concerns in delivering CG work on time and at quality

•
Keep up to date with relevant tools, software, and workflows, and advocate for their effective use on the show

•
Collaborate with grace, humility, inclusion, and open‑mindedness

What You’ll Need

•
5+ years of leadership in CG production supervision (e.g., VFX Supervisor, CG Supervisor, or comparable roles)

•
Proven leadership on CG animated projects across feature films, series, animated shorts, and/or video games

•
Expert knowledge in multiple CG disciplines and workflows including Modeling, Texturing/Surfacing, Rigging, Animation, Lighting, Shading, Compositing, and general FX

•
Expert working knowledge of industry‑standard 3D and imaging software including Maya, Houdini, Arnold, Nuke, and related packages

•
Samples and/or credits demonstrating excellence in CG and FX development and integrated, production‑level CG work

•
Excellent verbal, written, and digital communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across creative, technical, and production teams

•
Strong organizational and problem‑solving skills; able to discern priorities and find efficient workflows within time constraints

This role is based in Vancouver, British Columbia. Hybrid Role (Minimum requirement of 3 days a week in the office).

We rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, location, skills, and experience. The overall market range for this role is typically $280,000 - $420,000 CAD.  This reflects total compensation; we do not have bonuses.

title: Manager, Social Marketing
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

This is not just a community manager role.

This is not about posting calendars and managing handles.

This is internet marketing at a cultural scale.

We're looking for a cultural operator. A conversation hacker. A genuine content obsessive. Someone who understands the Indian internet deeply, watches everything, and knows how to turn moments into movements. You're as creative as you are analytical — as comfortable pitching a wild idea as you are reading a content slate and knowing exactly which title deserves the internet's attention this week. Loves content coming from different regions in India - Hindi and South. Social at Netflix is a growth engine, an intelligence system, and a brand love machine. If you can balance instinct with insight and culture with craft, this is your playground.

The Mandate

Build and Lead Conversation

•
Grow and nurture the most engaged OTT community in India.

•
Drive always-on cultural presence beyond Title launches

•
Ensure Netflix India consistently leads monthly share of voice and shapes how titles travel across press and KOL ecosystems.

Turn Social into Strategic Intelligence

•
Mine real-time audience feedback, sentiment, and heat signals.

•
Identify breakout moments early and course-correct underperformance fast.

•
Represent the audience voice in internal forums and influence marketing pivots.

You are both a cultural antenna and a performance radar.

Build Brand Love Through Culture

•
Show up meaningfully across festivals, cultural flashpoints, and everyday usage moments.

•
Create and scale social IP that reinforces Netflix's personality.

•
Work with creators for relevance and credibility, not transactional reach.

•
Bring a programmer's instinct to social — know which stories, scenes, and moments from our slate are worth amplifying, and when, across a title's entire lifecycle.

Drive Cross-Functional Impact

•
Work closely with internal teams and marcomms partners to ensure strong ownership on campaigns; align with cross-functional efforts led by Content, Brand, FSM, Publicity, Comms, Product, Partnerships and other teams.

•
Co-own tentpole brand beats across the year.

•
Own reactive excellence and boosting strategy to maximize cultural impact.

Expand Beyond Owned Handles

•
Recognize that the next wave of growth sits beyond metro-heavy legacy communities.

•
Partner with creators, collaborators, and ecosystem players to widen footprint.

Who You Are

•
8 to 10+ years of experience in social marketing, having worked in the entertainment industry, network/studio marketing, global lifestyle / digital-first brands, or a creative agency (experience in the entertainment category preferred).

•
Deep fluency in Indian internet behavior across cohorts and regions.

•
A genuinely creative mind — someone who concepts, not just executes; who pitches ideas that make a room go quiet.

•
Real content programming instincts — you read a slate, know how to sequence conversation around a title's lifecycle, and can spot what's culturally primed to travel before anyone else does.

•
An obsessive, personal love of content — you watch everything, have opinions on everything, and that excitement shows up in the work.

•
Able to balance creative instinct with data-led decision making.

•
Comfortable operating in ambiguity with high ownership.

•
Strong narrative thinker who understands how social shapes perception.

Why This Role Matters

At Netflix India, social does not amplify culture. It actively shapes it.

You will influence what trends, what headlines travel, how fandoms form, and how Netflix shows up in everyday conversation across India.

If you want to build cultural momentum, not just manage feeds, we would love to hear from you.

Monitor language performance metrics and emerging linguistic trends, proactively identifying and resolving quality or consistency challenges.

Collaborate with Global Resource Management to evaluate, refine, and implement vendor strategies and resource allocation for your language(s).

Oversee the selection, onboarding, and ongoing management of language-specific resources, ensuring a strong talent pipeline.

Build and maintain strong relationships with local dubbing and subtitling talent, studios, and industry communities to support creative excellence and market relevance.

Maintain and regularly update a database of language talent in partnership with vendors, performance, and specialization.

Monitor union, guild, and competitor activity to anticipate market shifts, inform strategy, and maintain competitive talent engagement.

5 or more years of experience in content localization, dubbing, subtitle, or international versioning for TV/film services.

Expertise in both dubbing and subtitling workflows, with a strong passion for language quality and cultural nuance.

Ability to handle a fast-paced environment, supervising several projects at various points of production (from development through delivery).

Linguistic expertise and previous localization experience in your local market language(s).

Understanding of localization workflows, tools, and best practices, with a track record of delivering high-quality language assets at scale.

Effective communication and relationship-building skills; able to work effectively in collaboration with creative, operational, and technical teams.

Ability to make independent decisions and navigate evolving priorities.

Analytical and solutions-oriented approach; able to identify root causes, optimize processes, and drive operational excellence.

title: Software Engineer 6 - Ads Account Foundations
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and we are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

•
Core Accounts: We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

•
Account Intelligence: We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

•
Account Cohort and Verification Automation: Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

•
Spend Attribution: We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

•
7+ years of experience building cloud-based applications with modern programming languages

•
4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

•
Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

•
Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

•
Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

•
Familiarity with Object/Entity lifecycle management and data governance associated with it.

•
Operational excellence experience with customer-facing APIs, including SLO tracking, incident management, and observability tooling,

•
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

•
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Nice to haves:

•
Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g  VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

•
Working knowledge of AI/ML/genAI techniques and an ability to apply them to the account management lifecycle or API reliability monitoring.

•
Early experience with customer-facing MCP concerns, such as defining tools contracts,  security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration), and integration with other AI agents.

•
Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

This role oversees the end-to-end creative and linguistic aspects of dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets, serving as the key point of contact for all language-specific localization efforts. This is in support and collaboration with Content Localization Title Producers. By monitoring language trends and maintaining deep market awareness, this role ensures every Netflix story resonates authentically with local audiences and upholds high standards of creative excellence.

Language Quality & Creative Excellence

Establish and enforce creative and quality standards and guidelines for all localized content in your assigned language(s), ensuring consistency across dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets.

Develop, implement, and maintain language strategies that prioritize localization efforts based on business impact and creative requirements.

Monitor language performance metrics and emerging linguistic trends, proactively identifying and resolving quality or consistency challenges.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Advocacy

•
Partner closely with Content Localization Title Producers, Product Localization, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to align on localization strategy, execution, and creative direction for your language(s).

Represent language-specific needs and perspectives in cross-team initiatives, integration projects, and support for emerging media types.

Ensure effective communication channels between local language teams and global stakeholders, advocating for both local nuance and global consistency.

Vendor & Resource Management

Inform the consolidation and strategic assignment of vendors at the language level to maximize efficiency, quality, and scalability.

Collaborate with Global Resource Management to evaluate, refine, and implement vendor strategies and resource allocation for your language(s).

Oversee the selection, onboarding, and ongoing management of language-specific resources, ensuring a strong talent pipeline.

•
Build and maintain strong relationships with local dubbing and subtitling talent, studios, and industry communities to support creative excellence and market relevance.

Maintain and regularly update a database of language talent in partnership with vendors, performance, and specialization.

•
Monitor union, guild, and competitor activity to anticipate market shifts, inform strategy, and maintain competitive talent engagement.

Champion the adoption of new workflows, automation, and technology to streamline localization processes and support the localization of emerging media types (e.g., interactive, live, podcasts).

5 or more years of experience in content localization, dubbing, subtitle, or international versioning for TV/film services.

Expertise in both dubbing and subtitling workflows, with a strong passion for language quality and cultural nuance.

Ability to handle a fast-paced environment, supervising several projects at various points of production (from development through delivery).

Linguistic expertise and previous localization experience in your local market language(s).

Understanding of localization workflows, tools, and best practices, with a track record of delivering high-quality language assets at scale.

Effective communication and relationship-building skills; able to work effectively in collaboration with creative, operational, and technical teams.

Ability to make independent decisions and navigate evolving priorities.

Analytical and solutions-oriented approach; able to identify root causes, optimize processes, and drive operational excellence.

Fluency in English and Polish required.
